title: If We Voted Tonight
text: "I'd like it noted that I'm only the messenger. If the colony voted tonight on what to do about you, the Autonomists would carry it. Not because they hate you. Because they think nobody can be sure of you, you included."

lines.text: "If that thing wakes, they'll want a hand on a switch. Earn it back or accept it. Those are the choices I can see."

notes: Says the colony's lean before Trust decides (v0.91.0): the bloc that would carry a vote, read at home after the Foundry; one of the three, once (lean-told). The Clause wakes a little later (clause-6 +3 lead, clause-patience).
